sloka: यदि वा त्रिदिवे सीतां न द्रक्ष्याम्यकृतश्रमः ।बद्ध्वा राक्षसराजानमानयिष्यामि रावणम् ॥५-१-४१॥
transliteration: yadi vā tridive sītāṁ na drakṣyāmyakṛtaśramaḥ ।baddhvā rākṣasarājānamānayiṣyāmi rāvaṇam ॥5-1-41॥

translations.english: "If I do not find Sita in heaven in spite of my efforts, I will bind that king of demons, Ravana and bring him here.
